title: tehas plugin --json
description: What tehas plugin --json prints, version 1: each plugin of TEHAS_PLUGINS, its pin, what is granted at the pin and its state. Plugins are a feature still being built, so this is not contract until the release that ships them, and a later step of the feature adds fields. Every object is closed, so a field tehas adds must be added here too. unbuilt is a plugin that is set and granted and not yet fetched or built; refused says why in refusal. The tests of console/ops/src/plugin.rs hold what the command prints to the samples beside this file, and those of console/core/src/plugin/manifest.rs hold the samples to this schema.
